title: UWB weak-NLOS structured dataset
authors: Philipp Peterseil | David Märzinger | Bernhard Etzlinger
version: Git commit fc165c5a68c95a0cfc80729905081654737842ad, full 24 train and 12 test files
finding: All 429,970 keyed triplets reproduce four local timestamp intervals. Three per-packet diagnostic rows describe one handshake. The electrically oriented tag has fixed reference separations per setup; there is no per-exchange physical-action timestamp.
rights: Public GitHub source. No license file in the pinned tree. Original binaries and row-level records are not redistributed. Only aggregate metrics, public identifiers and independent code are included.

title: UWB dynamic localization dataset
authors: Philipp Peterseil | Bernhard Etzlinger | Roya Khanzadeh | David Märzinger
version: Git commit 12f631086eaf1f6510e5feb98627a6aefa8b1feb. Three dynamic runs and the reference path audited.
finding: In three moving model-railway runs, 101,871 records contain six same-exchange radio timestamps. Eight nodes contribute in each file. The supplied track has 400 indexed points and no per-point clock; its geometry constrains motion without specifying the moment of actuation.
